decision: Confine observed literal-prefix commits to KDE through the existing resolved desktop presentation boundary; preserve previous GNOME, X11 and Niri preedit acquisition and retention.
reason: The full release gate exposes 15 existing failures because KDE stock-prefix behavior was applied globally in managed.rs. Changing owned fixtures into different protocols did not address that mechanism and is rejected.
verification: Existing pair/modifier tests remain unchanged; four-desktop key/SSI effects and existing exact manual receipt positive/revocation tests verify dispatch and first-observation order.
not_tested: Changed-byte native clients remain untested at decision time.
user_authorization: Fix all build/test failures and all three public issues, test the complete project and publish the next release.

consequences.implementation: One presentation-policy predicate takes the already resolved LayoutBackend. The existing managed owner uses it for observed-prefix acquisition and literal composition retirement. No second desktop detector, edit owner, output route or client exception.
consequences.authority: All current text, token, ownership, expiry, verifier and capability-change revocations remain unchanged. Default non-KDE stock acquisition still requires its previous Ready token when there is no observation.
consequences.tests: Keep existing pair and modifier tests unchanged. Add actual key plus surrounding-observation effects for GNOME, KDE, X11 and Niri. Bind the existing KDE stock tests explicitly to KDE.
consequences.rollback: The presentation predicate and its three managed call sites; retain the separately proven first-observation receipt-order fix. No installed runtime changed at decision time.
